999008199.text:
手間かけさせるね。ここまでだよ、シトリン。
神妙にしな

localizations.en: You made us work for it. But that's enough, Citrine. Give it up.

999008199.text:
いつものあんたならもっと苦戦してた。
でも、今のあんたは破れかぶれになってる

localizations.en: If you were your usual self, this would've been harder. But right now, you're acting desperate.

999008199.text:
こんなの後悔することになると思うけどね。
僕のやり方が一番丸い、一番正しいってさ

localizations.en: You're going to regret this, you know. My way was the safest—the right choice.

999008199.text:
正しいかどうかはともかくとして、
私はクリセルダたちを「管理」なんてしたくない

localizations.en: Right or not, I don't want to 'manage' Criselda and the others.

999008199.text:
それにヘルトたちも止めてみせる。
だから安心して！

localizations.en: And I'm going to stop Held and Zero too. So don't worry!

999008199.text:
安心できるか！　あの二人について
記憶を失ってるの、羨ましいぐらいだよ

localizations.en: How can I not worry?! I almost envy you for losing your memories of those two.

999008199.text: 私、昔はあの二人にビビッてたの？

localizations.en: Was I really that scared of them before?

999008199.text: ビビッていたというか、制圧されてたよ

localizations.en: Scared doesn't cover it. You were completely dominated by them.

999008199.text:
あの二人がヤバいってのは同感さ。
腕っぷしで言えば九偉人の中でも別格だからね

localizations.en: I'll agree those two are dangerous. In terms of raw power, they're in a league of their own among the Nine.

999008199.text:
でも、限りなく薄い勝算だろうが、
戦わなきゃいけないときがあるのさ

localizations.en: But sometimes you've gotta fight, even when your chances are slim to none.

999008199.text:
大人しく従っておけば僕らの命は無事なのに、
なんで、わざわざここで意地を張るのかな

localizations.en: If we just obey, we'll keep our lives. Why are you being so stubborn about this?

999008199.text:
イェルカはなんか覚悟決めちゃってるけど、
私は別に死ぬ気ないわよ？

localizations.en: Jelka might be ready to die, but I'm not planning on it, you know?

999008199.text:
どれだけ強かろうが、あの性格よ。アウグストたちの
命令にだって素直に従ってるわけじゃないんでしょ

localizations.en: No matter how strong they are, look at their personalities. They don't even follow August's orders obediently, right?

999008199.text:
実はちょっと考えていることがあるの。
それにはイェルカとシトリンの力が必要なんだけど……

localizations.en: Actually, I've been thinking about something. But I'll need both you and Jelka to make it work...

999008199.text:
考えてること？
なんだい、そりゃあ

localizations.en: Something you've been thinking about? What's that?

999008199.text:
突破口ってやつよ。力ずくで止めてみせたわけだし、
シトリンも協力してくれるわよね？

localizations.en: A way forward. We stopped you by force, so now you'll help us, right?

999008199.text:
このやり方は話し合いに近いけど、ちょっと違うの。
怒らせる可能性もあるかもだけど、いける気がするのよ

localizations.en: This approach is kind of like discussion, but not quite. It might make them angry, but... I think it could work.
